scope: All 119 residual celočisl- mathematical terminology forms in live v019 Latin sources.
choice: Normalize the full compound family to cěločisl-, preserving all 19 observed case-sensitive inflectional types and joining 138 already-canonical forms.
motivation: The official terminology is cělo čislo and the edition already predominantly compounds it as cěločisl-. The residual celočisl- layer was inconsistent and weakened the edition's adopted ě orthography in a central algebraic term.
alternatives_rejected: Retain mixed celo-/cělo- spellings; they denote one mathematical concept and provide no intelligibility benefit.
Expand every compound to a two-word phrase; that would require broad syntactic rewriting and break established adjectival terminology.
